title: Randers
extract: Randers is a city in northeast of the Jutland peninsula. It is Denmark's 7th largest city, with a population of 64,764. Randers is the main town and administration center of the Randers Municipality. By road it is 38.5 kilometres (23.9 mi) north of Aarhus, 43.8 kilometres (27.2 mi) east of Viborg, and 224 kilometres (139 mi) northwest of Copenhagen.
